description: Use this when someone asks for their research assets or for content already made from their studies: links the workspace's core assets (messaging house, positioning, buyer personas, competitive framing, brand health, verbatim library) and its reports, blogs and decks, and says which core assets do not exist yet. Core assets build when a study with real respondents completes. It only links what exists: do not use it to write new copy, headlines or posts. To make new content from a study, use gather_create_content.

scope.description: core: the six core assets; library: content made from studies; all: both (default).

name: gather_list_content
title: List your research content
